achievements.name: Full Auto
achievements.description: Get 5 kills with an AR.

steps: Equip any Assault Rifle in Quick Match or Ranked.
Get 5 kills with ARs (cumulative).

achievements.name: Designer
achievements.description: Customize a weapon.

steps: Open any Operator weapon customization.
Change a sight, barrel, grip, or underbarrel and confirm — one change unlocks it.

achievements.name: Speed Round
achievements.description: Win a round in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer in under 2 minutes.

steps: In Quick Match or Ranked, win a round in under 2 minutes.
Fast plant/defuse or aggressive site takes help — the round timer must end under 2:00.

achievements.name: Greaser
achievements.description: Get 5 kills with an SMG.

steps: In multiplayer, get kills with an LMG (e.g. M249, 6P41, T-95).
Accumulate the required LMG kills across matches.

achievements.name: Collector
achievements.description: Collect and save 5000 Renown.

steps: Play matches to earn Renown.
Keep at least 5,000 Renown saved in your balance (do not spend below that).

achievements.name: Fortress
achievements.description: Reinforce 2 breakable walls in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: As a Defender, reinforce two breakable walls in a single round (Quick Match or Ranked).

achievements.name: One Mind
achievements.description: Win 1 match without losing a single round in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Win every round of a Quick Match or Ranked match (no rounds lost).
Short Quick Matches are the easiest place to force a clean sweep.

achievements.name: Coming Through!
achievements.description: Breach and rappel through a window in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: As an Attacker, breach a window (Breach Charge / soft destruction) and rappel through that window.

achievements.name: Drone Destruction
achievements.description: Destroy 5 drones in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: As a Defender, shoot or destroy 5 Attacker drones across matches.

achievements.name: Woodworker
achievements.description: Place 5 barricades as a Defender in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: As a Defender, place 5 wooden barricades on doors/windows across rounds.

achievements.name: It Begins...
achievements.description: Complete 10 matches in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Complete your first multiplayer match (any mode that grants XP).
Finish the round — leaving early may not count.

achievements.name: First Class Defense
achievements.description: Play 10 rounds with a Pathfinder Defender in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Play 10 rounds with any Pathfinder Defender (Smoke, Mute, Castle, Pulse, Doc, Rook, Kapkan, Tachanka, Jäger, Bandit).
Quick Match or Ranked both count — finish rounds so progress saves.

achievements.name: Back in the Day ATK
achievements.description: Play 10 rounds with a Pathfinder Attacker in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Play 10 rounds with any Pathfinder Attacker (Sledge, Thatcher, Ash, Thermite, Twitch, Montagne, Glaz, Fuze, Blitz, IQ).

achievements.name: Ride Shotgun
achievements.description: Get 5 kills with a shotgun.

steps: Equip any shotgun (M590A1, SG-CQB, ACS12, etc.).
Get 5 kills with shotguns in Quick Match/Ranked.

achievements.name: Asset Protection
achievements.description: Destroy 20 gadgets in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Destroy 20 enemy gadgets (cameras, ADS, batteries, etc.) across matches.

achievements.name: Boomshakalaka
achievements.description: Win 10 matches of Bomb in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Destroy a destroyable hatch or reinforceable wall with explosives (nitro cell, impact, breach charge).
One successful breach destruction unlocks it for most builds of this trophy.

achievements.name: Objective Driven
achievements.description: Win 50 rounds in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Win 50 rounds (any objective) in Quick Match or Ranked.

achievements.name: Camera Shy
achievements.description: Destroy 10 cameras as an Attacker.

steps: As an Attacker, shoot or EMP enemy Observation Tools / default cams.
Destroy 10 cameras across matches.

achievements.name: Bang!
achievements.description: Get 5 kills with a handgun.

steps: Equip a handgun secondary or handgun primary operators.
Get 5 handgun kills in multiplayer.

achievements.name: Sureshot
achievements.description: Get 5 kills with a DMR.

steps: Equip a DMR (417, CAMRS, SR-25, etc.).
Get 5 DMR kills.

achievements.name: Globetrotter
achievements.description: Play 10 Multiplayer Matches on 10 different maps.

steps: Play matches on 10 different maps (rotate map preferences / Quick Match variety).
Complete 10 multiplayer matches that together cover 10 maps.

achievements.name: Accessorizing
achievements.description: Equip 50 weapon attachments.

steps: In loadout, add sights, barrels, grips, and lasers to guns.
Apply attachments 50 times total (across weapons/sessions).

achievements.name: Just Getting Started
achievements.description: Get 100 kills in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Play Quick Match or Ranked and finish rounds.
Reach 100 multiplayer kills cumulative.

achievements.name: Strength in Numbers
achievements.description: Win 10 games as a Squad in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Queue as a full/premade squad and win 10 matches in Quick Match or Ranked.

achievements.name: That Was Fast!
achievements.description: Find a bomb within 15 seconds of the Preparation Phase in Unranked/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: In Unranked/Ranked Bomb, drone during prep, then locate a bomb site within 15 seconds of the action phase.

achievements.name: To the Top
achievements.description: Reach Clearance level 50.

steps: Earn XP from matches and challenges.
Reach Clearance Level 50 on your account.

achievements.name: Brain Surgeon
achievements.description: Get 50 headshots in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Aim for headshots in Quick Match/Ranked.
Accumulate 50 headshot kills.

achievements.name: Perfectionist
achievements.description: Get 5 Flawless Victories in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Win 5 Flawless Victories (win the match without losing a round) in Quick Match or Ranked.

achievements.name: Oh Yeah!
achievements.description: Destroy a reinforced wall with Thermite's Exothermic Charge in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Pick Thermite on Attack.
Destroy a reinforced wall with Thermite's Exothermic Charge.

achievements.name: Don't Go in There!
achievements.description: Kill an Attacker caught inside Barbed Wire in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: As a Defender with Barbed Wire down, kill an Attacker while they are caught in your wire.

achievements.name: That Bullet Pen...
achievements.description: Get 10 kills through bullet penetration in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Get 10 kills by shooting through soft walls, floors, or other pen materials.

achievements.name: Can't Breach This
achievements.description: Win 100 rounds as a Defender in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Queue Defender and win rounds (Bomb/Secure/Hostage).
Win 100 rounds as Defender.

achievements.name: Overachiever
achievements.description: Win 100 rounds as an Attacker in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Queue Attacker and win rounds.
Win 100 rounds as Attacker.

achievements.name: To the Rescue
achievements.description: Revive injured teammates 10 times in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: DBNO teammates show a revive icon — hold interact to revive.
Revive teammates 10 times in Quick Match/Ranked.

achievements.name: Death From Above
achievements.description: Destroy a floor with a Breach Charge in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Place a Breach Charge on a floor/ceiling and destroy that floor in Quick Match or Ranked.

achievements.name: Fashion Week
achievements.description: Apply weapon skins to 30 weapons.

steps: Open the weapon customization cosmetics tab.
Apply skins to 30 different weapons.

achievements.name: That Was Close
achievements.description: Plant the defuser in 10 Bomb rounds in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: On Bomb, carry the defuser as Attacker and plant on a site.
Plant the defuser in 10 Bomb rounds.

achievements.name: Perimeter Secured
achievements.description: Win a match of Secure Area in Quick Match Multiplayer.

steps: Queue Secure Area in Quick Match.
Win a full match on Secure Area.

achievements.name: Specialist
achievements.description: Complete all Operator Specialties.

steps: Open Operator specialties / challenge tracks.
Complete every Operator Specialty listed until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.name: Old School
achievements.description: Play 10 rounds with all Operators from one Pathfinder ORG in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Pick one Pathfinder ORG (e.g. SAS: Sledge, Thatcher, Smoke, Mute).
Play 10 rounds with each operator from that ORG (40 rounds for a full ORG).

achievements.name: Close, but No Cigar
achievements.description: Deactivate the defuser in 5 Bomb matches in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: As a Defender in Bomb, deactivate (defuse) the planted defuser in 5 matches.

achievements.name: Senseless
achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies blinded by Stun Grenades in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Blind enemies with Stun Grenades, then kill 10 blinded enemies (Flash + follow-up).

achievements.name: Wrong Number
achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with Nitro Cells in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: As a Defender with Nitro Cell (C4), get 10 kills with Nitro Cells.

achievements.name: Meat Wall
achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a Breach Charge in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: As an Attacker with Breach Charges (Thermite soft charge, etc.), place on a wall/floor an enemy is on.
Get a kill with the Breach Charge explosion.

achievements.name: No Trespassing
achievements.description: Get 10 Claymore kills in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: As a Defender, place Claymores in common entry routes.
Get 10 Claymore kills.

achievements.name: Room Cleared
achievements.description: Get 10 Frag Grenade kills in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Bring frag grenades (Ash, Sledge, etc. depending on kit).
Get 10 kills with frag grenades.

achievements.name: Full Roster
achievements.description: Play 10 rounds with each Pathfinder Operator in Quick Match or Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Play 10 rounds with each of the 20 Pathfinder Operators.
Attackers: Sledge, Thatcher, Ash, Thermite, Twitch, Montagne, Glaz, Fuze, Blitz, IQ.
Defenders: Smoke, Mute, Castle, Pulse, Doc, Rook, Kapkan, Tachanka, Jäger, Bandit.
Use a checklist — ~200 rounds total. Finish matches so tracking saves.
warnings: Only Pathfinder (launch) operators count — Year 1+ ops do not. Tracking can delay; finish the match and restart if needed.

achievements.name: Jack of All Trades
achievements.description: Win 1 round with every Pathfinder Operator in Quick Match/Ranked Multiplayer.

steps: Win 1 round with every Pathfinder Operator (same 20 launch ops as Full Roster).
Combine with Full Roster: after each operator’s rounds, make sure you also bank a win.
Attackers: Sledge, Thatcher, Ash, Thermite, Twitch, Montagne, Glaz, Fuze, Blitz, IQ. Defenders: Smoke, Mute, Castle, Pulse, Doc, Rook, Kapkan, Tachanka, Jäger, Bandit.
warnings: Only Pathfinder (launch) operators count — Year 1+ ops do not. Tracking can delay; finish the match and restart if needed.
